crossRefs.note: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him, and threw him out.

translations.web: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him, and threw him out.
translations.bsb: Then he sent a third, but they wounded him and threw him out.
translations.kjv: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
translations.asv: And he sent yet a third: and him also they wounded, and cast him forth.
